cards.name: Grunge
cards.category: Grunge & Distort / Distort (Film Impact; folder not verified)
cards.summary: Film Impact distressed-film transition (internal AE.AE_Impact_Grunge). Around the cut both shots get crushed into a dark, desaturated, high-contrast grungy mix. Dirt, scratches, a vignette, a grey colourise, a flash and a slight frame wiggle are added, and then it clears to the incoming shot. In the 1 s gallery render the frames 0.3 s either side of the cut are almost clean, so the damage sits in the middle.
use_for: gritty documentary or crime-story act breaks
scandal or expose beats in political explainers
trailer cuts between archival and present-day footage
avoid: corporate, government or clean news packages, where the dirt reads messy
very dark footage, which goes almost black at the midpoint
cuts under 0.4 s, where the texture never reads
cards.equivalent: AE: crossfade with a film dirt/scratch overlay (or Fractal Noise) in Multiply mode, Curves/Levels crushing the blacks, Tint toward grey and a wiggle() on Position around the cut, plus a short Exposure flash.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 450 s cut (449.52-450.52 s), with no error. Centred needs about 0.5 s of handles on both clips. Apply by name with a duration. The gallery .prproj shows Effect Controls including Grunge 60, Dirt 80, Scratches 60, Detail 70, Vignette 10, Colorize 40, Flash Intensity 50, Strobe 1 and Wiggle X/Y 6. The spec cannot set these yet, so keep the defaults. Single-sided behaviour was not tested.

verified.note: Cut frame is a dark, crushed, desaturated grungy mix of plate A and plate B with scratches; frames either side are recognisable with slight darkening.

cards.name: Kaleidoscope
cards.category: Grunge & Distort / Distort (Film Impact; folder not verified)
cards.summary: Film Impact Kaleido (internal AE.AE_Impact_Kaleido). The picture is folded into rotating, mirrored kaleidoscope segments that zoom, with motion blur. At the cut it becomes a dense mandala, and the incoming shot unfolds out of the pattern. In the 1 s gallery render the frame is still fully abstract 0.3 s before and after the cut, so most of the duration is unrecognisable.
use_for: dream, memory or 'mind-bending AI' moments on the AI-education channel
avoid: serious news or political explainers, where it looks gimmicky
shots whose subject must stay identifiable, because faces and text dissolve into pattern for most of the duration
using it more than once per piece
cards.equivalent: AE: CC Kaleida on both layers, ramping Size and Rotation up into the cut on A and down out of it on B, with an opacity crossfade or hard cut at the peak and Directional/CC Radial blur for the smear.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 454 s cut (453.52-454.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Pieces (dropdown 0..5, default 2), Zoom 1200, Inner Zoom 400, Rotations -1, Movement (dropdown 0..4, default 4) and Enable Motion Blur on. The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and change only the duration. Keep it short (0.5-0.8 s) when the shots must stay readable.

verified.note: All three frames are abstract mirrored mandala patterns: plate A's stripes folded into segments before, a dense grey mandala at the cut, plate B still folded after.

cards.name: Lens Blur
cards.category: Lights & Blurs / Blur (Film Impact; folder not verified)
cards.summary: Film Impact Lens Blur (internal AE.AE_Impact_Lens_Blur). The outgoing shot defocuses like a real lens, with aperture-shaped bokeh, slight lens distortion and chromatic fringing. It crossfades to the incoming shot at peak blur, and the incoming shot pulls back into focus. In the gallery render the blur is moderate and confined to the middle: the frames 0.3 s either side are sharp, and the cut frame is a soft defocused mix of both shots.
use_for: time or location changes in documentaries
soft scene changes in interviews and explainers
pulling out of a title card into footage
avoid: fast energetic edits, where it feels slow
flat, dark footage with no highlights, where the bokeh never shows and it reads as a plain soft dissolve
cards.equivalent: AE: Camera Lens Blur keyframed from 0 to high on the outgoing layer and from high to 0 on the incoming layer, with an opacity crossfade at the peak blur.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 458 s cut (457.52-458.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Blur Amount 30, Aperture Edges 5, Gain 90, Lens Distortion 20, Chromatic Aberration 20 and Dissolve Time 40. The spec cannot set these yet, and at Blur Amount 30 the effect is moderate. Single-sided at a clip start it should focus in from the empty track (black), but this was not tested. It is a transition: look it up in the transitions list, not among the blur effects.

verified.note: Cut frame is a soft, defocused crossfade of both shots; the frames 0.3 s either side are sharp.

cards.name: Light Leak
cards.category: Lights & Blurs / Light (Film Impact; folder not verified)
cards.summary: Film Impact Light Leaks (internal AE.AE_Impact_Light_Leaks). Organic film light-leak streaks and spots wash over the frame with a bright flash and chromatic fringing, cover the cut and fade off the incoming shot. With default settings the leak is multicolour, not warm orange: the gallery render shows yellow-green at top-left, magenta and violet across the centre and a white wash. A faint warm-violet tint is still on the incoming shot 0.3 s after the cut.
avoid: hard news and data explainers, where it feels like a wedding video
overuse: three or more in a row looks cheap
cold or strict brand grades, which the magenta and green default colours clash with
already blown-out footage, where the leak disappears
cards.equivalent: AE: light-leak stock footage, or Fractal Noise + Colorama, in Screen/Add mode over the cut, with an opacity crossfade underneath at the brightest frame.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 462 s cut (461.52-462.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips. The name differs from the 'Light Leaks' video effect (plural) and from the 'Chroma Leak' and 'VR Light Leaks' transitions, so match the name exactly in the transitions list. The gallery .prproj shows controls Color Variation (dropdown 0..2, default 0), Hue 0, Strike Amount 80, Flash 75 and Exposure 32. The spec cannot set these yet; for a warm orange leak use 'Chroma Leak' instead.

verified.note: Cut frame has a magenta/violet leak across the centre, yellow-green at top-left and a white wash over a mix of both shots; the incoming shot is slightly warm 0.3 s after.

flash.basis: render: one bright multicolour wash over the cut

cards.name: Light Sweep
cards.category: Lights & Blurs / Light (Film Impact; folder not verified)
cards.summary: Film Impact Light Sweep (internal AE.AE_Impact_Light_Sweep). This is a hard-edged angled wipe with a bright warm-gold light beam riding the edge, like a shine pass on a logo, plus a slight emboss or relief on the edge. In the gallery render the default angle is diagonal (Angle 60): the beam travels from the lower-left to the right, with the incoming shot on the left of the beam and the outgoing shot on the right.
use_for: product or app-feature shots in AI-tool explainers
avoid: dark, moody documentary scenes, where it feels like an advert
repeating it between every shot
cards.equivalent: AE: Linear Wipe at about 60 degrees on the outgoing layer, plus a feathered warm-gold solid or CC Light Sweep tracked to the wipe edge in Add mode.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 466 s cut (465.52-466.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Angle 60, Reverse Direction off, Width 60, Wipe Feather 4, Intensity 36, Relief Mode (dropdown 0..1, default 1), Color #FFDFB3 and Colorize 50. The spec cannot set these yet, so the direction is fixed at the default.

verified.note: Cut frame shows a hard diagonal edge with a bright gold beam, plate B on the left and the outgoing shot on the right; gold glints sit at lower-left before and top-right after.

cards.name: Linear Wipe
cards.summary: Film Impact Linear Wipe (internal AE.AE_Impact_Linear_Wipe). A straight-edged, eased wipe with a small feather replaces the outgoing shot. In the gallery render the default angle is diagonal (Angle 60), with the incoming shot sweeping in from the lower-left and a little motion smear on the edge. Repeats (several parallel bands), Mirror and an optional coloured or glowing stroke on the edge are available.
use_for: soft-edge wipes between interview and B-roll
directional story beats (left to right = moving forward)
avoid: a slow hard-edged wipe, which looks like 1990s PowerPoint
emotional documentary moments, where a cut or dissolve is better
cards.equivalent: AE: Linear Wipe effect (Transition folder) on the outgoing layer, keyframing Transition Completion 0 -> 100 with eased keyframes, Wipe Angle about 60 degrees and a small Feather.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 470 s cut (469.52-470.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips. Do not confuse it with the 'Linear Wipe (Legacy)' video effect, which is keyframed on a clip and is not placed on a cut. The gallery .prproj shows controls Angle 60, Wipe Feather 5, Repeats 0, Mirror off and Enable Stroke off (with Width, Color and Glow Range). The spec cannot set these yet.

verified.note: Cut frame shows a diagonal, slightly feathered edge with plate B on the left and the outgoing shot on the right; small corner remnants are visible 0.3 s either side.

cards.name: Liquid Distortion
cards.category: Grunge & Distort / Distort (Film Impact; folder not verified)
cards.summary: Film Impact Liquid Distortion (internal AE.AE_Impact_Liquid_Distortion). The outgoing shot melts into a turbulent liquid warp, combined with a dolly or vertigo zoom, defocus and heavy motion blur, and the incoming shot settles out of the swirl. It is strong at default settings. In the gallery render the outgoing shot is already smeared 0.3 s before the cut, the cut frame is an unrecognisable marbled liquid, and the incoming shot is still swirling 0.3 s after.
use_for: 'reality bending' AI or deepfake explainer moments
music reels on a soft beat
avoid: news or political packages, where it feels unserious
talking-head to talking-head cuts, because warped faces look ugly
anything that must stay readable through the cut, since about 0.6 s of a 1 s transition is unreadable
cards.equivalent: AE: Turbulent Displace (high Amount, animated Evolution) plus a Scale push and Camera Lens Blur, ramped up on the outgoing layer and down on the incoming layer, with an opacity crossfade at the peak.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 474 s cut (473.52-474.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Strength 55, Turbulence 20, Speed 8, Dolly 60, Vertigo 150, Defocus 60 and Motion Blur 75. The spec cannot set these yet, so use the defaults and shorten the duration for a lighter touch.

verified.note: Outgoing shot is already smeared and warped before the cut, the cut frame is an unrecognisable marbled liquid, and plate B is still swirling with zoom blur after.

cards.name: Luma Fade
cards.summary: Film Impact Luma Fade (internal AE.AE_Impact_Luma_Fade). The dissolve is keyed on brightness, so one tonal range of the picture changes before the rest with a soft feathered edge, which looks more organic than a flat crossfade. Invert Luma flips the order. In the gallery render most of the frame is already the incoming shot at the cut, with only scattered fragments of the outgoing shot left, and both frames 0.3 s away are clean.
use_for: a classier alternative to Cross Dissolve in explainers
avoid: flat, evenly-lit footage, where it looks like a normal crossfade
very short durations, where the luma ordering cannot be seen
cards.equivalent: AE: Gradient Wipe on the outgoing layer with a luminance source (the layer itself or the incoming layer) as the Gradient Layer and Transition Softness about 25-50%, keyframing Transition Completion 0 -> 100.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 478 s cut (477.52-478.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Sample Source (dropdown 0..2, default 2; labels not verified), Feather 50, Softness 25, Contrast 0 and Invert Luma off. Whether brights or darks go first at default is not verified.

verified.note: Cut frame is mostly plate B with scattered tonal fragments of the outgoing shot (a small round motif, block rails, flowers); both side frames are clean.

cards.name: Mirror
cards.category: Transformers / Slide (Film Impact; folder not verified)
cards.summary: Film Impact Mirror (internal AE.AE_Impact_Mirror). This is a push in which the frame is filled with mirrored (flipped) copies of the picture instead of empty edges. The shots slide along the push direction with motion blur, the reflected tiles form symmetrical seams, and the two shots dissolve into each other near the middle. In the gallery render the cut frame is split into mirrored panels showing both shots, and the frames 0.3 s either side are nearly clean.
use_for: energetic social reels and montage beats
fashion or architecture shots with strong lines
avoid: faces and on-screen text, which mirror into nonsense at the seams
sober news and documentary work
cards.equivalent: AE: Motion Tile with Mirror Edges on both layers, animating Tile Center/Position across the cut with Directional Blur and a short crossfade at the midpoint.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 482 s cut (481.52-482.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Mirror Angle 90, Push Distance 100, Push Angle 270, Mirror Push on, Scale 0 and Enable Motion Blur on. Do not confuse it with the 'Mirror' video effect (Distort), which has the same name: look it up in the transitions list. Single-sided use was not tested.

verified.note: Cut frame is split into mirrored vertical panels of plate B with a faint striped ghost of plate A; side frames are recognisable but slightly displaced with a mirror seam.

cards.name: Mosaic
cards.category: Grunge & Distort / Stylize (Film Impact; folder not verified)
cards.summary: Film Impact Mosaic (internal AE.AE_Impact_Mosaic). This is a tile wipe, not a whole-frame pixelation. The frame breaks into a grid of square tiles (Num. Tiles 8 by default) that switch from the outgoing to the incoming shot in a staggered, partly random sweep. Tiles in mid-switch show as lit, softened blocks. In the gallery render the cut frame is a patchwork of both shots, and the frames 0.3 s either side are almost clean.
use_for: 'assembling' reveal of a screenshot, document or dashboard
avoid: cinematic trailers and serious documentaries, where it looks cheap
durations over about 1 s, which drag
faces as the main subject, which get chopped into mismatched tiles
cards.equivalent: AE: Card Wipe (Rows/Columns about 8 x 5, Flip Order Random, small Timing Randomness) or Block Dissolve on the outgoing layer, with the incoming layer underneath.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 486 s cut (485.52-486.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips. Do not confuse it with the 'Mosaic' or 'Mosaic (Legacy)' video effects (real pixelation): look it up in the transitions list. The gallery .prproj shows controls Shape (dropdown 0..1, default 0), Num. Tiles 8, Light Amount 60, Tile Height 25, Mode (dropdown 0..2, default 0), Angle 180, Variation 50 and Stroke Amount 0. The spec cannot set these yet.

verified.note: Cut frame is a patchwork of square tiles, some from each shot and some in a lit mid-switch state; side frames are almost clean.

cards.name: Motion Camera
cards.category: Smart Tools / Motion (Film Impact; folder not verified)
cards.summary: Film Impact virtual camera-move transition (internal AE.AE_Impact_Warp). A fast zoom with rotation, 3D tilt and a vertigo or dolly warp, plus heavy motion blur, joins the two shots as if one camera move carried through the cut. It has 12 motion presets and spring or bounce curve options. In the gallery render the cut frame is an unreadable zoom/rotation smear of the incoming shot, and the frames 0.3 s either side are sharp, so the move is concentrated at the cut.
use_for: joining two moving drone or vehicle shots
avoid: static interviews, where the move feels unmotivated
subtitles, lower thirds or logos baked into the clips, which smear
repeated use in one sequence, which causes motion fatigue
cards.equivalent: AE: Transform effect (Scale + Rotation with a high Shutter Angle) on an adjustment layer across the cut, or a 3D camera push with motion blur, with a hard cut at peak speed.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 490 s cut (489.52-490.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips. Its internal name is Impact 'Warp', not 'Camera'. The gallery .prproj shows controls Presets (dropdown 0..11, default 0), Zoom -1000, Rotation 30, Vertigo -75, Horizontal Tilt 18, Vertical Tilt 12 and Motion Blur 40. Preset labels and the exact camera path per preset were not verified, so treat the default as a fast zoom-rotate push.

verified.note: Cut frame is a heavy zoom/rotation motion-blur smear of plate B; side frames are sharp.

cards.name: Motion Tween
cards.category: Smart Tools / Motion (Film Impact; folder not verified)
cards.summary: Film Impact motion transition (internal AE.AE_Impact_Animate). It is believed to animate smoothly between the two clips' transform states, so a framed picture or graphic glides to its new size and position, and it also offers 27 motion presets, Move/Dolly/3D rotation controls and cropping. Verified: on two full-frame clips with default settings and identical transforms nothing moves, and it renders as a plain full-length crossfade (Dissolve Time 100).
use_for: moving a picture-in-picture or screen recording from one position to another in explainers
news layouts where a box grows from a side panel to full screen
logo or graphic repositioning between scenes
avoid: two full-frame clips with identical transforms, where it is only a crossfade (use Cross Dissolve)
unrelated clips, where the motion has no meaning
cards.equivalent: AE: keyframe Position, Scale and Rotation of one layer from shot A's framing to shot B's framing with eased (Easy Ease) keyframes, swapping the source at the end.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 494 s cut (493.52-494.52 s), with no error. It needs two clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Presets (dropdown 0..26, default 0), Move [0,0], Dolly 0, Rotations X/Y/Z 0, Cropping Left/Right/Top/Bottom and Dissolve Time 100. The tween-between-clip-transforms behaviour is inferred from the Film Impact original and is not verified. Set different Motion position or scale on the two clips first, and preview before relying on it.

verified.note: Cut frame is a plain 50/50 crossfade of both shots with no movement, as the card says for full-frame clips with identical transforms.

cards.name: Neon Wipe
cards.summary: Film Impact Copy Machine, renamed (internal AE.AE_Impact_Copy_Machine). A thin glowing neon line, magenta-pink #FF00AA by default with a purple glow trail, sweeps diagonally across the frame like a scanner bar and reveals the incoming shot behind it. In the gallery render the line enters from the left before the cut, sits about halfway across at the cut and exits bottom-right after it, so it is visible for most of the duration.
avoid: documentaries, political news and serious topics, where it feels gimmicky
brands whose palette clashes with the default magenta (the colour cannot be set from a spec yet)
cards.equivalent: AE: Linear Wipe on the outgoing layer, plus a thin magenta solid or shape bar tracked to the wipe edge with Glow (or Saber) in Add mode.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 498 s cut (497.52-498.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Direction (dropdown 0..3, default 3), Angle 115, Line Thickness 12, Color #FF00AA, Colorize 70, Beam Intensity 100 and Blend Mode (dropdown 0..3, default 0). The spec cannot set these yet, so the line stays magenta.

verified.note: A thin white-core magenta neon line with purple glow sweeps left to right: at the left before the cut, about halfway at the cut, at the bottom-right corner after.

cards.name: Page Peel
cards.category: Page Peel (Film Impact; folder not verified)
cards.summary: Film Impact Page Peel (internal AE.AE_Impact_Page_Peel), the current replacement for 'Page Peel (Obsolete)'. The outgoing shot curls away like a sheet of paper, with lighting, a shadow and motion blur on the curl, and reveals the incoming shot underneath. The back of the page shows a desaturated grey, motion-blurred image rather than a plain colour. In the gallery render the curl runs diagonally from the left edge and exits off the right edge just after the cut.
use_for: 'turning the page' to a new chapter in explainers
avoid: serious news, cinematic trailers and modern reels, where it reads as cheap 2000s
repeating it between many shots
cards.equivalent: AE: CC Page Turn on the outgoing layer, keyframing Fold Position from one edge across the frame, with the incoming layer underneath.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 502 s cut (501.52-502.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips. Match the name exactly: 'Page Peel (Obsolete)' and the old 'Page Turn' / 'Peel Back' are also in the list, so do not use a substring match. The gallery .prproj shows controls Mode (dropdown 0..1, default 0), Radius 20, Angle 210, Lighting 50, Shadows 20, Back Side (dropdown 0..1, default 0) and Desaturation 20.

verified.note: Cut frame shows a page curl across the middle with a desaturated grey motion-blurred back, plate B revealed on the left; the curl is leaving off the right edge after.

cards.name: Panel Wipe
cards.summary: Film Impact Panel Wipe (internal AE.AE_Impact_PanelWipe). Angled panels (135 degrees by default) slide across the frame in a stagger to reveal the incoming shot. The panels behave like tinted glass, with slight refraction, texture, warm highlights and chromatic fringing at their edges. In the gallery render the cut frame is split into diagonal bands of both shots, with the first band visible top-left 0.3 s before the cut and the last leaving bottom-right 0.3 s after.
avoid: emotional documentary moments, where it feels mechanical
very long durations, where a slow stagger looks like a PowerPoint blinds effect
cards.equivalent: AE: 2-3 angled shape-layer strips used as a track matte, each sliding across with a few frames' offset, plus a little CC Glass or chromatic offset on the strip edges.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 506 s cut (505.52-506.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Angle 135, Num. Panels 1 (range 1..5), Panel Offset 50, Wipe Type (dropdown 0..2, default 2), Refraction 20, Texture 55, Color #FFDFB3 and Chromatic Aberration 80. The spec cannot set these yet.

verified.note: Cut frame is split into diagonal bands of both shots with soft glassy edges; a first band shows top-left before and a last band leaves bottom-right after.

cards.name: Phosphor
cards.category: Dissolve (Film Impact; folder from a web-search snippet, not verified)
cards.summary: Film Impact Phosphore (internal AE.AE_Impact_Phosphore). This is a fiery burn-through, not a CRT glow. Holes driven by luminance open organically in the outgoing shot, edged with white-hot orange (#FF6400) incandescent rims like burning film or paper, and reveal the incoming shot. In the gallery render the cut frame shows the incoming shot through large burnt holes with glowing edges, and bright white-orange embers are still flaring on the incoming shot 0.3 s after the cut.
use_for: dramatic or explosive story beats in documentaries and trailers
scandal, expose or 'burning issue' reveals in political explainers
retro film-burn montages of archival footage
punchy reel transitions on a hit
avoid: sober news packages and condolence or tragedy stories (fire imagery reads as insensitive)
faces and on-screen text, which get holes burnt through them mid-transition
chaining several in quick succession (bright flashing embers raise photosensitivity concerns)
cards.equivalent: AE: Gradient Wipe on the outgoing layer driven by its own luminance or a Fractal Noise map, with the matte edge extracted and given an orange Glow/Tint in Add mode (or CC Burn Film), over the incoming layer.
cards.scripting: Harvest placed it centred, 1 s at the 510 s cut (509.52-510.52 s), with no error. Centred needs handles on both clips. The gallery .prproj shows controls Sample Source (dropdown 0..2, default 0), Softness 50, Feather 25, Reverse Direction off, Color #FF6400, Colorize 80, Highlight 90 and Grunge Amount 10. The spec cannot set these yet. Embers linger after the midpoint, so leave a beat before any text appears on the incoming shot.

verified.note: Cut frame shows plate B through large organic burnt holes in the outgoing shot with white-hot orange glowing rims; bright embers still flare 0.3 s after.
